title: Filipino crew in Singapore Strait collision expected to be sent home—Cacdac
summary: The 21 Filipino seafarers aboard a bulk carrier involved in a collision in the Singapore Strait are expected to be sent home after disembarkation, Migrant Workers Secretary Hans Leo Cacdac said…

blocks.text: The 21 Filipino seafarers aboard a bulk carrier involved in a collision in the Singapore Strait are expected to be sent home after disembarkation, Migrant Workers Secretary Hans Leo Cacdac said Thursday.
